sections.content: [Placeholder passage text for Children's play. The passage discusses the uses and importance of children's play: building magical kingdoms helps develop creativity; board games involve negotiation and turn-taking. Recent changes include growing city populations and reduced free play due to fear of strangers, fear of traffic, and increased testing in schools. International policies on play face difficulty finding funding, and research needs to study the impact of play on the rest of the child's life. It also discusses how self-control links to academic success, how play reveals medical issues, a study on dolls and writing, a Lego storytelling experiment, and current views on the significance of play.]
